text:
maya-oncall: paging in — multiple alerts for routing flapping between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu, high 5xx spike on generation and some 504s at the edge. looks like health-checks are oscillating and the smart-routing is bouncing traffic across regions + falling back to quantized model variants. initial spike started ~00:00 UTC.
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-3250001234 — Region ping-flap causing fallback churn. Pager notified. Runbook: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/region-fallback
pagerduty-bot: page to maya-oncall, priya, jun. Escalation policy: routing-fallback-prod
eli: oncall are you seeing customer impact? which customers?
maya-oncall: yes — two top-tier customers (acme, numeral) report slow responses and occasional timeouts. error rate up ~12x on model endpoints in impacted region cluster. traces show lots of re-routes in a tight window. sample log: 
```
2026-03-15T00:02:31Z router: route=rw-alpha -> rw-alpha-quant (us-west) reason=health-fail
2026-03-15T00:02:32Z router: route=rw-alpha -> rw-alpha (eu) reason=probe-recovery
2026-03-15T00:02:32Z router: route=rw-alpha -> rw-alpha-quant (us-east) reason=health-fail
```
priya: OK. probable cause: aggressive probe TTL + flap protection disabled for some regions after recent config change. mitigation plan: 1) pause automatic cross-region failover 2) temporarily pin important customers to a stable region/model 3) increase probe cooldown + enable flap dampening.
jun: agree. can we flip the circuit-breaker to manual so router won't bounce while we stabilize? suggest override TTL=60s and flap window=90s.
carlos: I'm ready to apply overrides. running temporary commands now — will keep changes scoped and reversible.
carlos: running: 
```
# stop automatic cross-region failover
redwoodctl routing update --policy region-fallback --auto-failover=false --scope temporary
# set circuit-breaker override (60s) and flap window
redwoodctl routing update --policy region-fallback --cb-override 60 --flap-window 90
```
ops-bot: action accepted. applying to routing-policy: region-fallback (us-east/us-west/eu). targeting control-plane 6 nodes.
priya: while that's rolling, I'll pin ACME and NUMERAL to us-east stable variant to stop customer visible churn. command: 
```
redwoodctl route pin --customer acme --model rw-alpha-stable --region us-east-1 --duration 2h
redwoodctl route pin --customer numeral --model rw-alpha-stable --region us-east-1 --duration 2h
```
maya-oncall: done, pinned. monitoring alert: ACME errors dropping but general 5xx still present as route override propagates.
jun: also increasing health probe cooldown and enabling flap-protection in probe config: 
```
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap health-probes -p '{"data":{"cooldown_secs":"90","success_threshold":"3","flap_protection":"true"}}'
```
ops-bot: probe config updated in eu/us-west/us-east (canary then full).
eli: timeline / customer impact for postmortem?
maya-oncall: customers affected: ACME, NUMERAL (high), plus transient errors for ~45 other tenants. No data loss. Impact window ~00:00–00:18 UTC. SLO blips for request latency and 99th percentile.
priya: current metrics (1 min after overrides): routing bounce count down 85%, 5xx reduced 70%. still watching.
carlos: revert plan: once stable for 15m, gradually re-enable auto-failover with higher flap thresholds. I'll prepare the rollback commands.
maya-oncall: good. notify support + account teams for ACME/NUMERAL and advise that we pinned them and are monitoring.
ops-bot: support message template queued — will send once you ack.
maya-oncall: ack, send now :email: @support-team @acct-ops
pagerduty-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity reduced to SEV2.
eli: nice work. please assign postmortem owners and list action items.
priya: assigning postmortem to maya-oncall + priya. action items: 1) revert/verify routing-policy defaults 2) add automatic flap-protection tests in staging 3) tune probe TTLs per-region 4) update runbook to include pinned-route steps.
jun: I'll open a PR for probe defaults and add e2e for flap scenarios.
maya-oncall: will draft initial incident timeline and customer notes. follow-up meeting in 2h. 
ops-bot: Incident INC-3250001234 annotated: mitigation applied (routing override + pinned routes + probe cooldown change). Actions logged to ticket.
maya-oncall: closing this thread for live triage, will continue in postmortem doc. thanks team :thumbsup:
